purpose: Base-game permanent unlocks that materially change a League build. These are dependency edges, not boss guides or a second combat-values table.

policy.base_game_first: Record the normal-game requirement here, then apply official Equilibrium quest auto-completion, relics, blessings or passives as a separate overlay.
policy.no_stale_values: Do not copy old damage or XP values into this graph. Numeric combat values belong in current combat data.
policy.region_rule: A quest location is not automatically a hard League region requirement. Keep geography as a hint unless Equilibrium or a prior League taxonomy gives usable evidence.
policy.dedupe_rule: Boss and regional codex drops stay in the regional upgrade/reward datasets. This file owns dependency state, not a duplicate drop table.

rules: A weapon is permanently sacrificed to store its special attack in the amulet.
The stored special attack uses the player's current weapons for damage and accuracy rather than the sacrificed weapon.
The stored special attack must match the combat style currently being used.
equipment_models.league_treatment: Model the stored special separately from equipped weapon state; region and drop availability are separate dependencies.

equipment_models.name: Zamorakian sliver enchantments
equipment_models.account_rule: Consuming an enchantment permanently upgrades every current and future copy of the affected equipment on the account.

equipment_models.name: Blessed flask
quest_dependencies: As a First Resort for sandstone glassmaking
Plague's End for crystal-flecked sandstone / Prifddinas
Legacy of Seergaze progression for the chain-link mould used in the silvthril-chain branch

equipment_models.name: Call of the Sea replacement bonuses
Lumberjack replacement hatchet bonuses
equipment_models.level_scaling: Woodcutting levels above the tree requirement further improve success chance; this stacks conceptually with the tool-tier replacement bonus.

equipment_models.name: Herb bag progression
equipment_models.league_treatment: This is a hard Anachronia weekly-currency route. Track the base and upgrade as two 200-point milestones rather than collapsing them into a generic 400-point item.

equipment_models.name: Gem bag progression
equipment_models.league_treatment: Daemonheim is a hard Forinthry dependency. Keep the 2,000-token base bag and 20,000-token upgrade as separate milestones.

equipment_models.name: Artificer's measure
equipment_models.category: high-level gem container and skilling off-hand
requirements: 40 Dungeoneering through the upgraded gem bag
dependency_notes: Forinthry: upgraded gem bag through Daemonheim rewards.
Tirannwn: crystal-flecked sandstone / Prifddinas route used by blessed molten glass.
Morytania: partial Legacy of Seergaze progression for the chain-link mould used in the silvthril chain.
Player-owned Ports can supply crystal-flecked sandstone as a slower alternative and remains an account-time bottleneck rather than an elective region.
equipment_models.league_treatment: Do not present 99 Crafting and 102 Archaeology as the whole requirement. The consumed upgraded gem bag and glass/chain branches create real cross-region pressure.

equipment_models.name: Advanced gold accumulator
equipment_models.effect: Automatically adds 90% of monster coin drops to the money pouch and destroys the remaining 10%.
equipment_models.league_treatment: Daemonheim is a hard Forinthry dependency in this project. Keep the 1,500,000-token purchase and optional 500-Slayer-point tool-belt unlock as separate milestones.

equipment_models.name: Seedicide
equipment_models.effect: Destroys selected seed drops and awards twice the Farming experience that planting the seed would give, provided the player has the Farming level to plant it.

pickup_upgrade.effect: Collects selected seeds instead of destroying them.

equipment_models.league_treatment: Do not hard-assign Seedicide to one region: Asgarnia, Kandarin and Thaler routes are distinct alternatives.

equipment_models.name: Split dragontooth necklace
equipment_models.effect_summary: Restores Prayer points when qualifying bones are buried; works with bones processed by the Bonecrusher.
equipment_models.historical_correction: The remaster reduced the token cost from 17,000 to 15,500 and the Dungeoneering requirement from 60 to 41; the 60 Prayer requirement remains a separate equipment gate.

equipment_models.name: Demon horn necklace
equipment_models.effect_summary: Restores 50–150 Prayer points when qualifying bones are buried or supported ashes/ghosts are absorbed with the attuned ectoplasmator.
equipment_models.historical_correction: The remaster kept the 35,000-token cost but reduced the Dungeoneering requirement from 90 to 75.

equipment_models.name: Amulet of zealots
equipment_models.effect_summary: Increases the effect of supported single-stat boosting prayers by 10% while imposing a Prayer bonus penalty.
equipment_models.historical_correction: The remaster kept the 40,000-token cost and reduced the Dungeoneering requirement from 48 to 38.

equipment_models.name: Chaotic grimoire
equipment_models.active_effect: +7% critical-strike chance while the grimoire is active.
equipment_models.league_treatment: Store token/page supply separately from any combat-engine crit calculation so League token multipliers can change acquisition without rewriting the effect.

equipment_models.name: Ruinous weapon family

shared_properties.warped_stone_source: Tradeable drop from bosses on warped floors; drop rate improves with floor size.

equipment_models.league_treatment: Forinthry supplies the token shop and warped-floor stone path. Keep the 12% Warpbane modifier target-scoped; do not treat these as global T100-damage weapons.

equipment_models.name: Occultist Necromancy necklace chain

upgrade_chain.name: Occultist's hex necklace
region_pressure: asgarnia: Saradomin's hum from God Wars Dungeon

upgrade_chain.name: Occultist's blood necklace
upgrade_chain.blood_necklace_shard_source: Monster drop; Edimmu are a known source.

equipment_models.league_treatment: Keep the base necklaces as Forinthry shop unlocks and represent the T80/blood upgrades as cross-region material chains. Do not infer a region for Blood necklace shard solely from one monster source.

equipment_models.name: Gravite and Chaotic Necromancy weapons
equipment_models.league_treatment: These form the Forinthry Necromancy weapon ladder below the T90 Ruinous guard/lantern. Keep them separate from the surface Necromancy weapon upgrade path.

equipment_models.name: Asylum surgeon's ring
requirements: Complete a replay in under 37 minutes
equipment_models.league_treatment: Do not hard-assign the mansion to an elective region from map intuition. Apply official Equilibrium quest auto-completion separately, and keep the ring's combat proc values out of progression until reverified from a current source.

equipment_models.name: Crystal fishing rod
effects: 5% more likely to catch fish at compatible fishing spots
Can be augmented for Invention perks
equipment_models.league_treatment: A major permanent Fishing tool unlock even when Fishing Frenzy or another activity is better raw XP.

equipment_models.name: Tavia's fishing rod
requirements: Rare red uncharted island map from Deep Sea Fishing or Travelling Merchant route
effects: 10% increased fishing success rate when compatible
Can trigger all three Deep Sea Fishing boosts
Can be augmented
equipment_models.league_treatment: Record as a rare ceiling item, not baseline Kandarin power. A player cannot plan around obtaining it quickly.

equipment_models.name: Trahaearn exoskeleton
requirements: Plague's End reward in the normal game
effects: 25% chance to avoid being stunned and damaged while pickpocketing
25% chance to avoid snake bites in Pyramid Plunder
Can inherit black ibis experience benefits once those are owned
equipment_models.league_treatment: Prifddinas/Tirannwn is the useful regional value. Resolve the quest through Equilibrium auto-completion before treating it as a manual requirement.

equipment_models.name: Sana's fyrtorch
equipment_models.league_treatment: Use the canonical item name. The existing loose major-upgrade row used a non-item placeholder name for this reward.

equipment_models.name: Tagga's corehammer
effects: +10% Mining critical strike chance
+35% Mining critical strike damage
Chance for deathspore arrow tips from core ores
equipment_models.league_treatment: Use the canonical item name. The critical-strike bonuses remain useful outside core ores; only the arrow-tip effect is core-ore specific.

equipment_models.name: Memory dowser
effects: Gather memories from wisps up to 7 tiles away
Supports ranged, low-movement Divination gathering
equipment_models.league_treatment: City of Um/Gate is currently mapped to Misthalin by historical League precedent pending Equilibrium confirmation.

equipment_models.name: Runic attuner
effects: Attunes to eligible Runecrafting altars
At 1-49 energy, attuned-altar crafting gains 200% additional Runecrafting XP
Every 5 energy gives a 50% rune multiplier at the attuned altar
Every 7 energy allows choosing an altar
Every 10 energy grants an attuned-altar teleport
Every 25 energy guarantees 1-4 magical thread
At 50 energy, attuned-altar crafting gains 2,400% additional Runecrafting XP and resets energy
equipment_models.league_treatment: Use the post-29-September-2025 effect, not the original release tooltip. Do not assume it is always the best XP/hour route; altar sequence and Soul altar use matter.

equipment_models.name: Orthen furnace core
equipment_models.league_treatment: Track the unlock, but do not label it BIS for pure XP. Its situational effects can lose to augmented off-hands and other setups.

equipment_models.name: Imcando pickaxe
requirements: Golden mining suit before gilding a dragon pickaxe
equipment_models.league_treatment: Do not use historical enchanted-Imcando bonus-XP data. The enchanted variant was removed in 2019.

equipment_models.name: Pickaxe of Earth and Song
region_pressure: Imcando pickaxe progression comes from the Keldagrim/Lava Flow Mine chain.
Crystal pickaxe progression comes from Prifddinas crystal-tool infrastructure.
equipment_models.league_treatment: Treat Fremennik plus Tirannwn as the normal self-sufficient chain unless Equilibrium adds alternate tool sources.

equipment_models.name: Imcando hatchet
requirements: Imcando hatchet fragments from bird nests
equipment_models.league_treatment: Use the Fort's current working Misthalin taxonomy until Equilibrium publishes a different boundary.

equipment_models.name: Skeka's hypnowand
requirements: Read the aged journal in the Warped Depths of the Daemonheim Dig Site before pieces can drop
region_pressure: Forinthry owns Daemonheim and the Warped Depths journal gate.
Pieces then come from Anachronia activities including Big Game Hunter, Rex Matriarchs, vile blooms and the Agility Course.
equipment_models.league_treatment: Do not label this Anachronia-only. The Daemonheim journal gate is a real Forinthry dependency in the normal acquisition path.

equipment_models.name: Balarak's sash brush
effects: +5% excavation success rate
+5% mattock base precision
10% chance for an additional material while excavating
5% chance for Chronal Focus at 100% sprite focus
region_pressure: Brush pieces come from the Warped Depths of the Daemonheim Dig Site.
The damaged brush is shown to Sharrigan outside Anachronia Base Camp to learn restoration.
equipment_models.league_treatment: Surface both Forinthry and Anachronia in planner dependencies.

equipment_models.name: Artificer's measure
equipment_models.category: Crafting and Construction skilling off-hand cross-region chain
requirements: Chain link mould from the Legacy of Seergaze route
Crystal-flecked sandstone or an alternate player-owned ports source
effects: Stores gems like the upgraded gem bag
Always applies the Ithell Voice of Seren harp benefit while playing harps
5% chance to duplicate glassblown items and urns, including potion and crystal flasks
Scroll of proficiency chance multiplied by 1.25
Crafting/Construction buff can stack to 5% after proficiency procs
equipment_models.league_treatment: Do not hard-require every listed region. Crystal sandstone has an alternate Ports source and quest auto-completion can change the mould route, but region choices strongly affect self-sufficient acquisition.

equipment_models.name: Hatchet of Ember and Glade
equipment_models.category: tier-90 augmentable Woodcutting tool cross-region chain
region_pressure: Crystal-hatchet progression is tied to Prifddinas crystal tools and a dragon hatchet base.
Dragon hatchets have a direct Dagannoth Kings source in the Fremennik region.
Imcando-hatchet fragments come from the tier-3 Woodcutter's Grove, currently mapped to Misthalin by historical League precedent.
The Shard of the Lumberjack is purchased from Wilfred north of Falador in Asgarnia.
Normal-game quest and dragon-forge requirements can add further access pressure and must be resolved through the Equilibrium quest overlay.
equipment_models.league_treatment: Do not assign the finished hatchet to one region. Its normal self-sufficient chain deliberately touches multiple region picks.

equipment_models.name: Hatchet of Bloom and Blight
equipment_models.category: tier-100 augmentable Woodcutting tool follow-on chain
requirements: Normal-game Kili Row and Pieces of Hate progression
effects: Level-100 augmentable hatchet
Designed as the highest-level Woodcutting hatchet and best XP/log-yield tool in its update tier
equipment_models.notes: This inherits the full multi-region Ember and Glade chain before adding the tier-100 Ramarno and moonstone progression. Keep the component-level region map conservative until every 2026 League quest/access override is known.
equipment_models.league_treatment: Surface it as the late-game continuation of Ember and Glade without inventing a single-region requirement.

equipment_models.name: Spring cleaner progression

upgrade_ladder.unlock: Automatically high-alchemises configured salvage drops at the cost of one spring per salvage.
Automatically disassembles configured salvage drops without consuming a spring; free disassembly does not advance upgrades.
Further improves the cleaner's older dismantle/research functionality.
Higher-tier cleaner with the full pre-9001 salvage configuration set.
Extends supported automatic cleaning to noted salvage drops.

equipment_models.supply_bottleneck: A self-sufficient account can craft tight springs, but the tensile-part and subtle-component cost is the meaningful long-run constraint. Store the component recipe and upgrade ladder rather than a volatile spring coin price.
equipment_models.league_treatment: The 43 Invention unlock is only the first gate. Track the 600-spring free-disassembly milestone and 10,000-spring noted-salvage milestone separately, and let regional component-supply rows determine how practical those milestones are.

equipment_models.name: Summoning charm-conservation tools

records.name: Spirit gems
records.charge_rule: One charge is consumed whenever a charm is saved.
records.note: Higher-tier gems increase the chance; gems are most valuable on scarce crimson or blue charms.

equipment_models.league_treatment: Charm-saving effects reduce supply consumption; they do not change familiar unlock requirements or tertiary-item geography.

equipment_models.name: Salve amulet (e)
quest_dependencies: Haunted Mine for the base salve amulet
Lair of Tarn Razorlor for Tarn's diary and the enchantment
equipment_models.effect: Increases damage and accuracy by 20% for all combat styles against undead monsters.
equipment_models.stacking_note: The current Wiki documents stacking with the full Slayer helmet, Void Knight equipment, the Undead Slayer perk and the Undead Slayer ability; the bonus is on-hit and does not buff damage-over-time abilities or conjures.

equipment_models.name: Holy wrench
quest_dependencies: Rum Deal for the Holy wrench
Pieces of Hate for the Dungeoneering prayer-necklace interaction
effects: Increases Prayer restored by supported prayer-restoring potions while carried or worn.
After Pieces of Hate, increases Prayer restored by Dungeoneering prayer necklaces by 10%.
equipment_models.league_treatment: Keep the Rum Deal item gate and Pieces of Hate enhancement separate so official Equilibrium quest auto-completion can satisfy either dependency without inventing a region exception.

equipment_models.name: Attuned ectoplasmator
equipment_models.effect: Absorbs eligible ghost remains and destroys demonic ashes for the normal Prayer experience that scattering or burying them would grant.
equipment_models.league_treatment: Do not assign this to one elective region. The base cleaner and recharge material have multiple ghost-source routes; region value belongs to the source rows that supply them.

ability_unlocks.name: Dragonkin Laboratory greater melee codices
ability_unlocks.league_treatment: The dungeon is in the Wilderness. Use Forinthry for base geography, then apply any explicit Equilibrium access exception separately.

ability_unlocks.name: Limitless
ability_unlocks.league_treatment: Treat 2,000 vital sparks and the Sophanem source as the base-game acquisition path; League drop multipliers belong in the League ruleset.

ability_unlocks.name: Greater Concentrated Blast
ability_unlocks.league_treatment: Kerapac is in Senntisten. Misthalin is the current working League taxonomy, not an Equilibrium-specific locality reveal. Do not import old damage numbers from PvME.

ability_unlocks.name: Magma Tempest
ability_unlocks.league_treatment: The TzekHaar Front is in Senntisten. Keep Misthalin as a working League mapping only until Equilibrium publishes a finer locality rule.

ability_unlocks.name: Zamorakian Undercity ability codices
ability_unlocks.league_treatment: Do not hard-gate these to a region yet. The Undercity entrance and Zamorak encounter produce an explicit cross-boundary ambiguity already tracked by the planner.

ability_unlocks.name: Reprisal
ability_unlocks.league_treatment: Use the existing Desert/Heart of Gielinor region mapping; do not copy Telos strategy or enrage data into the planner.

ability_unlocks.name: Greater Sonic Wave
ability_unlocks.league_treatment: The monsters are accessed through the Fort Forinthry crypt. Keep the historical Misthalin working taxonomy visibly provisional because the crypt is north of the Fort in Wilderness geography.

ability_unlocks.name: Invoke Lord of Bones
ability_unlocks.league_treatment: Use the current Fort Forinthry working taxonomy only as planner precedent until Equilibrium confirms the locality.

ability_unlocks.name: Vampyrism
ability_unlocks.effect: Heals 5% of damage dealt, capped at 50 life points per hit.
ability_unlocks.aspect_rule: Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
ability_unlocks.historical_correction: This replaces the removed Vampyrism aura. Do not model an aura duration/cooldown or War's Wares aura purchase.

ability_unlocks.name: Penance
ability_unlocks.effect: Restores Prayer points equal to 5% of damage received, capped at 100 Prayer points per hit.
ability_unlocks.aspect_rule: Only one Aspect can be active at a time.
ability_unlocks.historical_correction: This replaces the removed Penance aura. Do not model an aura duration/cooldown or War's Wares aura purchase.

ability_unlocks.name: Golden Touch and Unsullied
ability_unlocks.dedupe_note: Limitless uses the same 2,000-vital-spark acquisition system and is already represented separately on main.
ability_unlocks.league_treatment: Treat the 2,000-spark requirements as base acquisition costs. League drop multipliers and access overrides remain separate modifiers.

ability_unlocks.name: Ingenuity of the Humans
requirements: Discover the Ingenuity of the Humans ability codex research
ability_unlocks.league_treatment: Do not assign a single region from the inventor's workbench. Region pressure comes from alchemical-onyx and component supply chains.

ability_unlocks.name: Demon, Dragon and Undead Slayer ability codices
requirements: Relevant codex blueprints from the Elite Dungeon Reward Shop
ability_unlocks.league_treatment: Model blueprint access, Black stone hearts, onyxes and component supply as separate dependencies. Do not collapse all three codices to one Elite Dungeon or one elective region.

prayer_unlocks.name: Praesul codex curses
prayer_unlocks.league_treatment: One Praesul codex unlocks one supported level-99 curse. Ancient Curses remain the base prayer-book prerequisite; apply League quest/passive overrides separately.

prayer_unlocks.name: Divine Rage
prayer_unlocks.league_treatment: Sanctum access follows the City of Um working taxonomy already used by the planner; keep that locality provisional.

prayer_unlocks.name: Eclipsed Soul
prayer_unlocks.league_treatment: Gate of Elidinis follows the City of Um working taxonomy already used by the planner; do not turn that precedent into an Equilibrium confirmation.

prayer_unlocks.name: Rapid Renewal
prayer_unlocks.effect_summary: While active, natural life-point regeneration occurs five times as quickly.

recipe_shop_gate.name: Meilyr Recipe Shop
recipe_shop_gate.note: Relevant unreadable recipe pages must be discovered before the permanent recipe can be bought from Lady Meilyr.

tiers.benefit: Stackable unfinished overload and overload-salve batches

consumable_unlocks.name: Adrenaline renewal potion
consumable_unlocks.effect: Restores 40% adrenaline over six seconds and triggers the normal adrenaline-potion cooldown.

consumable_unlocks.name: Meilyr potion recipe page purchase
consumable_unlocks.effect: Provides the Dungeoneering reward-shop route for a Meilyr combination-potion recipe page before the corresponding recipe is bought from Lady Meilyr.
consumable_unlocks.historical_correction: The 11 May 2026 remaster reduced this reward-shop cost from 500,000 to 100,000 Dungeoneering tokens; the Dungeoneering requirement remained 75.
consumable_unlocks.league_treatment: This is one recipe-page acquisition route. Keep the permanent Lady Meilyr recipe purchase and Tirannwn access as separate dependencies.

consumable_unlocks.name: Charming potion
consumable_unlocks.effect: Increases the base number of charms dropped by a monster by 1.
consumable_unlocks.special_charm_rule: Special charms such as abyssal and talon beast charms are affected unless their source has a separate exclusion.
consumable_unlocks.league_treatment: Apply the flat +1 before temporary League drop multipliers only when the official League rules confirm the stacking order.
